# Security policy

If you believe you have found a security problem in this repository or on flotize.com, please tell us privately so we can fix it before it is made public.

- Use **Report a vulnerability** on this repository's Security tab (GitHub private vulnerability reporting), or
- email info@flotize.com with "Security" in the subject.

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem, and do not access or change data that is not yours while testing.
